ability.name: Horus Lance Launcher
ability.description: Fires 5 projectiles that pierce shields and destructible surfaces before erupting into flames. They can pass through floors, ceilings and adjacent rooms.

ability.name: D.O.M. Panel Launcher
ability.description: Deploys bulletproof panels from a distance; they can be opened or closed with a trigger at the top of the door.

ability.name: T.R.I.P. Connector
ability.description: When two devices are placed in line of sight a laser forms between them. Enemies that trip it are slowed and injured; more devices create a larger laser web that denies a room.

ability.name: V10 Pantheon Shells
ability.description: Controls two linked shells: one operated directly and one acting as a shielded observation tool. She can switch between them but only operate one at a time; losing either shell severs the connection to both.
